name: nitrate
description: Collaboration for AI video agencies: send one campaign brief to creators and review every result with context.

interface.shortDescription: Keep every AI video creator on the same campaign.
interface.longDescription: Nitrate gives AI video agencies one collaboration workflow. A lead sends the campaign brief, brand assets, assignments, and required folders; creators return finished media with the prompt and notes attached; the lead reviews everything in one place.
defaultPrompt: Package this brief and send it to my creator.
Pull my Nitrate assignment into this workspace.
Return this draft with its prompt and handoff notes.
